findings: BLOCKER o15-stage-identity-implement.py inspect_cases (~lines 226-228): `rel.advance(ledger, source_states[index], _view(adapter_states[index]), source_states[prefix], _view(adapter_states[prefix]), case['source']['actions'][index], index, index)` passes 8 args; semantic.py advance requires 9 `(pairs,s_before,q_before,s_after,q_after,s_action,q_action,si,qi)`. TypeError is caught by `except READ`, sets ledger_ok=False, so every prefix>=1 is 'unverifiable' and every case returns 'unproved': the checker can never emit 'supported' or 'counterexample'. Minimal correction: pass action twice, `..., action, action, index, index)`, matching check.py audit_case `r.advance(pairs, ss[i], core_view(aa[i]), ss[prefix], core_view(aa[prefix]), action, action, i, i)`.

BLOCKER o15-stage-identity-implement.py:72 `ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]`; its declared recovery path experiments/v3/swarm-research-20260911-155142/obligation_checks/stage_identity.py (recovered-proposals.json) is four levels deep, so parents[3] resolves to `experiments/` and sys.path gains `experiments/experiments/v3/cut-source-overnight/batch-05`, failing `import semantic` at load. Minimal correction: parents[3]->parents[4], exactly as the sibling control at obligation_controls/ correctly uses (control-build ~line 19).

o15-stage-identity-implement.py _replay (~lines 116-120) reads `qp = trace['q_profile']` but drops the original contract's `d.exact(qp, d.subprofile(trace['profile']))` 'fixed Q occurrence positions' check (adapter_traces.py restore ~line 77) despite claiming to mirror adapter_traces.py:57-73; a forged q_profile consistent with the invocation mask passes. It also omits audit_case's `case['source']['actions']==case['adapter']['actions']` and equal-profile requirements (check.py ~lines 113-115); advance is fed only source actions, so divergent adapter actions go unaudited. Minimal correction: require actions/profile equality and bind qp (import a_domain.subprofile or an external proof).

INTEROP o15-stage-identity-control-build.py run_controls (~lines 152-213) injects `inspect_cases`; under the checker's digest-bound inspect_cases, probes mutating event patches/actions (forged-staged-signatures, staged-payload-detached, nonidentical-envelopes, dropped-stage-origin) make _replay raise -> status 'unproved', while `detected` is defined only as status=='counterexample' (~line 178), so corruptions report undetected. Discrimination holds only under the control's own hash-trusting _views audit. Minimal correction: pin run_controls to the module's inspect_cases or count 'unproved'/'uninspectable' as detected.
